_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for every non-herb, non-medicine item. tools/generate.py emits registration Java, models, textures and lang for all of these.

items.name: Glass Vial
items.lore: Thin-blown glass. Everything an apothecary makes ends up in one of these.

items.name: Clay Cup
items.lore: A fired clay cup. Teas taste of earth and are better for it.

items.name: Vial of Spring Water
items.lore: Clean water, stoppered. The base of most tonics.

items.name: Cup of Spring Water
items.lore: A cup of clean water waiting for herbs.

items.name: Herbal Oil
items.lore: Pressed from seeds. Carries poisons into metal better than anything else.

items.name: Herbal Spirits
items.lore: Sharp spirits distilled for dissolving stubborn resins.

items.name: Salve Base
items.lore: Beeswax and oil worked together. Holds a medicine against the skin.

items.name: Moonwater
items.lore: Water that has held moonlight - or so the old apothecaries insist. Rarely made, never wasted.

items.name: Salt of Purity
items.lore: A white salt that pulls impurities out of a brew and leaves it clean.

items.name: Ember Ash
items.lore: Ash that stays warm for hours. Wakes up any warming recipe.

items.name: Frost Crystal
items.lore: A shard of unnatural ice that never melts in the hand.

items.name: Essence of Life
items.lore: A green light trapped in liquid. It makes medicine take hold faster and deeper.

items.name: Shadow Ichor
items.lore: Thick, dark and cold. Poisons made with it are not survivable by accident.

items.name: Pruning Shears
items.lore: Cut stems cleanly and the plant lives to grow again.

items.name: Seed Pouch
items.lore: Keeps seeds dry and sorted. Worn at the belt, it never fails to catch a few extra.

items.name: Herbalist's Journal
items.lore: Half field guide, half recipe book, entirely your own.

items.name: Journal Page: Field Notes
items.lore: Someone's careful notes on gathering wild herbs.

items.name: Journal Page: Medicines
items.lore: A folded page of tonic recipes, stained with old spills.

items.name: Journal Page: Poisons
items.lore: The handwriting here is small and very precise.

items.name: Journal Page: Ancient Apothecary
items.lore: Parchment from an apothecary older than any village you have visited.

experimental.name: Experimental Tonic
experimental.lore: A muddy, unnamed brew. It does something. Whether it is what you wanted is another matter.

experimental.name: Experimental Tea
experimental.lore: A cup of something herbal and unlabelled.

experimental.name: Failed Mixture
experimental.lore: The mixture curdled. Drinking it would be an act of pure optimism.
